description: Which of a table part's two names is the table's name? Packages this library wrote were opened in Excel Desktop: one table named MyTable with displayName 'My Display Name' and one with displayName MyDisplay, interactively; and one with name Internal and displayName Shown beside the formulas SUM(Shown[h]) and SUM(Internal[h]), through the Excel oracle (tools/excel-oracle/run.ts --xlsx), which reads each formula cell back and re-saves.
verdict: displayName is the table's name: the identifier structured references resolve and the one Excel requires to be a valid name. name carries nothing a model needs apart from it.
